Preserve navy wool sack coat and navy kepi, sky-blue trousers, worn brown ankle boots, light tan straps, dark pack, rolled blanket and round tin canteen from Input1. Real natural human anatomy, weathered wool/leather/metal, restrained photoreal historical illustration, no toy/CG/plastic/cartoon style.

ONE SQUARE RGBA source, exact TWO COLUMNS TWO ROWS of equal square cells, read left-to-right top-to-bottom. Four poses ONLY, genuinely transparent empty background. Keep each FULL figure, BOTH boots, musket stock, full barrel and attached socket bayonet wholly in its own cell with AT LEAST 45 native pixels fully transparent space to every edge. Pose2 RECOVERY: draw stock inward by right hip with elbows back, fore-end and bayonet angled DOWN LEFT roughly30degrees, rearward weight on planted boot, visibly different from raised guard. Full weapon inside cell.
Pose3 CLOSE BLOCK: compact two-handed protective cross-body rifle held steeply UP LEFT around65degrees, knees flexed and elbow tucked, supported feet, clear different silhouette from0 and2.

Hold face/pack/canteen/blanket placement, musket mechanics and whole-body size coherent. All four face LEFT; newly authored west views, no mirroring. Maintain clear native alpha boundaries around actual subjects only, including inter-arm/leg gaps. No flames, gore, aura, modern weaponry or extra limbs.

Preserve its square canvas and exact2column2row equal square layout, same realistic Union A man, LEFT bearing/camera, navy kepi/coat, sky-blue trousers, straps, round canteen, pack/blanket, same complete musket with socket bayonet. Preserve all four distinct guard, waist-level short lunge, low recovery and steep raised block. They must remain four NEW complete original poses.
CRITICAL CORRECTION: uniform reduction of ALL FOUR COMPLETE bodies AND full weapons TOGETHER to70percent of current size inside their own fixed square cells. Move each reduced whole pose into the CENTER of its individual cell. DO NOT crop or shorten rifle. Every bayonet tip, cap, canteen, arm, boot and stock must sit at least45 native pixels inside ALL FOUR edges of ITS OWN cell. Current top-right lunge weapon intrudes into top-left and lower-right raised bayonet into upper row: completely eliminate these crossings with smaller whole figures and abundant transparent room. Keep complete twohanded grips and natural same anatomy/weapon proportions; one same scale across everyphase, never separately resize a pose to normalize bodyheight.
